audit.why: Levels 1-3 belong to Rumble (Flamespitter 600 cone, free-cost kit); Ryze is even from 4 and ahead once items land. Text already reflects this.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Rumble the First-item and 2+-item rows in BOTH layers, contradicting the packet chart (Skill, then Ryze), the 54.86% win rate, and whys[5]/whys[6] which say Rod of Ages and Seraph's flip the lane.
audit.why: Ryze's spikes are item-gated: Rod of Ages removes the HP deficit and Seraph's makes the E-Q-W loop near-permanent, while Rumble's Scrap Shield is on a flat 6s and cannot keep pace across rotations.
audit.corrected: phases[5]/win[5] -> Skill; phases[6]/win[6] -> Ryze, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d did not state the decisive interaction: Rune Prison (W, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) only ROOTS if the target already has Flux from E; unfluxed it is just a slow. Nothing on the page said so.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Ordering E before W is the whole matchup pattern, and E also resets Overload.
audit.corrected: Both descriptions rewritten to name the Flux condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Equalizer (R) terrain cutting off a dashless Ryze's retreat was never stated.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule terrain-cuts-retreat; Ryze has no mobility outside Phase Rush, so Flash is the only out through the burn wall.
54.86% over 381 games matches the page framing.

edits.before: Shield + speed on demand — trade just after he burns it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: E-Flux a minion beside him first — then W roots instead of slowing and Q resets.

edits.before: W is your anti-dive insurance — spending it on poke invites every engage in his kit.
edits.after: Unfluxed, Rune Prison only slows — no root, no rotation, just a walk into Flamespitter.

edits.before: Rumble's R is a zoning death zone in skirmishes — respect it or you eat full ticks while Flamespitter burns you simultaneously.
edits.after: The Equalizer walls off your retreat and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage, and never fight inside its burn.

notes: packet suspectNames flag on wants.foe[1] 'Burn Electro Harpoon' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Electro Harpoon is the correct name. The kit file's knockup and terrain flags on Scrap Shield contradict Riot's own description (shield + move speed only) — treated as tooltip-parse misfires and not written to the page. Rumble's basic abilities cost 0 mana, so cooldown-window advice keyed to mana is not usable here; Scrap Shield's flat 6s and Flamespitter's 10/9/8/7/6 are the real windows.
